content: WXT 0.21.5 (npm, published 2026-10-26; Node >=22; peers vite ^6.3.4||^7||^8, typescript >=5.4) remains the default MV3 extension framework per multiple 2026 comparisons; Plasmo 0.90.5 unpublished since 2025-05 (stale); CRXJS 3.0.0 is a Vite plugin, Chromium-only, no helpers. WXT content script UI: createShadowRootUi (needs cssInjectionMode 'ui'), createIntegratedUi, createIframeUi; anchor + ui.autoMount() for dynamic elements; SPA navigation via 'wxt:locationchange' event; ctx.* helpers for invalidated contexts.
